config_name: Galaxy Tab S10+ — Dimensity 9300+, 12GB RAM, 512GB, 12.4" Dynamic AMOLED 2X + Slim Keyboard Cover (priced in)

specs.ports: 1x USB-C 3.2 (DP out, DeX), pogo pins for keyboard cover — no 3.5mm, no HDMI
specs.keyboard_notes: Slim Keyboard Cover (BBY 18469762) included in price: scissor keys, NO trackpad (trackpad only on the $299 Book Cover Keyboard); pogo-pin powered, no charging
specs.pen_support: S Pen INCLUDED in box (Bluetooth air actions, IP68)
specs.os: Android 14 (One UI 6.1) at launch; 7 years OS + security updates promised; Samsung DeX desktop mode

battery.notes: 10,090mAh. Lab Wi-Fi-web runs ~12-14h; users report ~9-11h mixed real use. 45W charging, ~2h to full.

price.notes: Bundle price = tablet (current best new retail) + keyboard, per the config definition. Components: Tab S10+ 512GB $1,799.99 (BBY SKU 18390512) + Slim Keyboard Cover $219.97 reg (BBY 18469762, sale $131.97) = $2,019.96 cover-in price. Cover-only price: $219.97 reg / $131.97 sale.

offers.name: Bundle: tablet + keyboard (config price includes the keyboard). Tablet listing 1799.99 + keyboard per price.notes.

reviews.quote: The AI tablet has a display problem: developed specially for AI functions, but Samsung is breaking new ground with its choice of processor.

praises: 512GB + microSD means years of offline video, games, and LumaFusion projects without juggling storage (r/Samsung)
DeX desktop mode with the keyboard cover: real multi-window desktop UI on a 12.4" AMOLED
S Pen in the box at zero extra cost — users constantly contrast this with Apple's +$169 Pencil
Galaxy phone parity: Quick Share, Second Screen, auto call/text relay — continuity rivals Apple within the Galaxy bubble
At this tier the $300 storage delta still undercuts any 512GB iPad Pro by ~$700 with a better screen per dollar
complaints: DeX is per-app: banking apps and many popular apps refuse to window, and Chrome has no desktop mode — desktop promise is half-kept
Slim Keyboard Cover has NO trackpad — the $299 Book Cover Keyboard tax remains
$300 over the 256GB buys capacity, not capability — microSD covers most of that need for $30
AMOLED PWM flicker at low brightness bothers light-sensitive readers
Dimensity 9300+ is a modest uplift over the S9's Snapdragon — some GPU benchmarks regressed

design_philosophy: The capacity tier of Samsung's flagship slate — same AMOLED, S Pen, IP68, and 7-year pledge as the 256GB, aimed at users who keep media and creative projects local. It is also the tier where the storage math gets soft: microSD mitigates, so this buy is about convenience headroom, not capability.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from the NBC-reviewed S10+ 256GB anchor per SHARED-tab-s10.md: identical silicon, +0.3 creative_work for 512GB scratch headroom. No verbatim pro score retrievable (bot-walls, disclosed). keyboard_trackpad 5.5 = priced-in Slim cover is keys-only. microSD mitigates soldered storage. Image URL is BBY CDN SKU guess.
standouts: 512GB + microSD: effectively unlimited local library on the best tablet screen class
Still ~$700 under a comparable 512GB iPad Pro with S Pen included
7-year update pledge applies to every tier
dealbreakers: Trackpad requires the pricier $299 Book Cover Keyboard
$300 storage premium is weak value when microSD exists — most buyers should take 256GB
